name: perrinn_fw_sst_half_3elem
notes: Turbulence-model check on a design variant: the 3-element wing (one element removed from the 4-element baseline), k-omega SST instead of Spalart-Allmaras, same layered half-wing setup, 85.6 mm. SA gave S.Cl -0.7502, S.Cd 0.1237, Cl/Cd 6.06 (baseline SA 5.35). Question: does SST also put the 3-element wing's efficiency above the 4-element baseline (SST baseline S.Cl -1.1565, S.Cd 0.2119, Cl/Cd 5.46)? Sensitivity test, not a design optimisation.
